sentences.en: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. I'm Zhan Haojing, a high school student.
sentences.cn: 晚上好，女士们先生们。我是詹昊晶，一名高中生。

sentences.en: I'm also a puppet performer.
sentences.cn: 我还是一名木偶表演者。

sentences.en: Look at this puppet. If I move my fingers, it will come to life!
sentences.cn: 看看这个木偶。如果我动动手指，它就会活过来！

sentences.en: I was born into a family of Minnan puppet performers.
sentences.cn: 我出生在闽南的一个木偶戏表演世家。

sentences.en: My grandpa and my mum are both among the best.
sentences.cn: 我的外公和我的母亲都是这行中的佼佼者。

sentences.en: They tell stories with their hands.
sentences.cn: 他们用手讲述故事。

sentences.en: I loved the stories my grandpa and my mum told with their hands.
sentences.cn: 我喜欢外公和妈妈用手讲述的故事。

sentences.en: However, things changed when I became a teenager.
sentences.cn: 然而，当我成为一名青少年时，情况发生了变化。

sentences.en: I felt less close to the art because people thought puppets were too old-fashioned.
sentences.cn: 我觉得与这门艺术不那么亲近了，因为人们认为木偶太老式了。

sentences.en: I didn't want to be part of puppetry unless I was asked to.
sentences.cn: 除非有人要求，否则我不想参与木偶表演。

sentences.en: One day my mum showed me a performance by my grandpa's teacher.
sentences.cn: 一天，妈妈给我看了外公老师的一场表演。

sentences.en: The finely made puppets and their exciting movements brought back childhood memories.
sentences.cn: 精致的木偶和它们激动人心的动作带回了童年的记忆。

sentences.en: Then and there, my love for puppetry started to grow again.
sentences.cn: 就在那时，我对木偶表演的热爱重新燃起。

sentences.en: I posted my doubts about the future of puppetry online.
sentences.cn: 我在网上发布了关于木偶表演未来的困惑。

sentences.en: To my surprise, the post was flooded with comments expressing warm feelings.
sentences.cn: 令我惊讶的是，帖子被表达温暖情感的评论淹没了。

sentences.en: Many people showed their love for the art of puppetry and encouraged me to hold on.
sentences.cn: 许多人表达了对木偶表演艺术的热爱，并鼓励我坚持。

sentences.en: A truth hit me - it was my duty to keep the art alive because puppetry was in my blood.
sentences.cn: 一个真相击中了我——让这门艺术保持活力是我的责任，因为木偶表演在我的血液里。

sentences.en: The art will be popular again if young people are interested in it.
sentences.cn: 如果年轻人对它感兴趣，这门艺术就会再次流行起来。

sentences.en: So I held a puppet show at school.
sentences.cn: 于是我在学校举办了一场木偶表演。

sentences.en: When I finished performing, I looked up and saw a surprising picture: the students were on the edge of their seats.
sentences.cn: 当我表演完，抬头看到一幅令人惊讶的画面：学生们都聚精会神地看着。

sentences.en: Their eyes were glued to the puppets.
sentences.cn: 他们的眼睛紧盯着木偶。

sentences.en: After a warm cheer, they came to ask where they could see a full performance.
sentences.cn: 在热烈的欢呼之后，他们来询问在哪里能看到完整的表演。

sentences.en: The positive reply from the young viewers gave me more courage.
sentences.cn: 年轻观众们的积极回应给了我更多勇气。

sentences.en: Since then, my puppet shows have drawn more attention both from home and abroad.
sentences.cn: 从此，我的木偶表演在国内外都引起了更多的关注。

sentences.en: The old art is getting more interest and new stories.
sentences.cn: 这门古老的艺术正在获得更多的兴趣和新故事。

sentences.en: With more and more people joining in, I believe the special magic of this traditional art will last forever!
sentences.cn: 随着越来越多的人加入，我相信这门传统艺术的特殊魔力将永远持续下去！
